plan.name: Record closed work and stop refused effects
plan.summary: Poll closed issues as well as open ones, record a person's merge or a started issue's closure once as an external observation without restarting its ordinary work, and clear stale active state labels even when a final post already exists. Persist non-transient GitHub 4xx refusals across issue effects, including pull request publication and final cleanup: quote the operation and GitHub's message once, label the issue for a person, and wait for a new writer's retry while preserving recorded work, transient-error handling and lease checks; pending refusals take precedence over closed-issue cleanup and remain discoverable even if posting or labeling fails. When scope finds an empty diff, read the pull request again and record its merge through the existing merged path if it merged; defer on a failed read and retain the scope refusal for an unmerged empty change. Update SPEC.md and README.md to describe closed-issue reconciliation, refusal reporting and retry, and the merge-race check, citing the existing decisions each changed SPEC bullet rests on, including D-0036, D-0064, D-0069, D-0105, D-0109, D-0122, D-0265, D-0266, D-0267 and D-0274 as applicable. The merger records the new decision for issue #434; this change tests the watcher plumbing and preserves the proved protocol and recovery cores.

tests.name: TestClosedPoll434RecordsHumanMergeAfterIssueAutoCloses
tests.says: The next poll records a person's merge once and clears stale active labels when the pull request and issue closed between polls, including work already waiting for a person.

tests.name: TestClosedPoll434RecordsIssueCloseWithoutMergingOpenPR
tests.says: Closing a started issue produces one issue-close record and clears stale labels without merging or closing its still-open pull request.

tests.name: TestClosedPoll434RecordsCloseBeforePullRequestExists
tests.says: Closed started issues without pull requests receive a final closure record without resuming queued work; untouched closed issues start no work and get no post.

tests.name: TestClosedPoll434CleansTerminalHistoryWithoutAnotherPost
tests.says: A poll clears historical active state labels on closed issues already recorded as merged, closed or completed plans, preserving unrelated labels and posting no duplicate final record.

tests.name: TestClosedPoll434RetriesLabelCleanupWithoutRepeatingMergeRecord
tests.says: Interrupted label cleanup after a closed issue's merge record recovers on the next poll without repeating that record.

tests.name: TestOtherPermanentEffects434WaitForAWriter
tests.says: Permanent refusals to open a child issue, close a replacement draft, post a proposal, change labels or delete a branch are reported once and remain stopped across polls and restart until a writer retries the original work.

tests.name: TestPermanentEffect434SurvivesAReportFailure
tests.says: If reporting a permanent refusal fails transiently, another watcher completes the report without repeating the refused effect or its completed build.

tests.name: TestPullRequestRefusalsWaitForAWriter434
tests.says: A permanent refusal to open a modeled or plumbing pull request is quoted once and waits across polls and a fresh watcher until a writer retries; transient answers remain retryable.

tests.name: TestAnEmptyScopeRechecksThePullRequest434
tests.says: When main acquires a pull request's head during a step, the factory rereads the pull request and records a person's merge instead of a false scope failure; a failed read defers, and a truly unmerged empty change remains refused.

tests.name: TestPermanentRefusalsKeepTheirMessage434
tests.says: GitHub's original permanent-refusal message survives the client error, including a 404, while existing error identities and permanent status classification remain intact.
